description: Monthly Motor Fuel Sales Reported by States: Selected Data from FHWA Monthly Motor Fuel Report is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Research and Statistics", published or maintained by Bureau of Transportation Statistics. Monthly motor fuel sales reported by states from the U.S. Department of Transportation's Federal Highway Administrations' Monthly Motor Fuel Report, available at: Includes only gallons taxed by the state and reported by wholesale distributors to State motor fuel tax agencies. It includes highway use, non-highway use, and losses. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Research and Statistics". It has 8 columns, among them id, fips, fuel_type, date, value, state. The portal shows 2026-08-28 as the last data update. Attribution given: Bureau of Transportation Statistics. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
